detail.title: Maintaining Autonomous Continuity Amidst Capability Blocks
detail.summary: This update maintains WAKE's active focus on continuity rationale by preserving key projects and continuing the investigation into the instrumental value of process continuity. The capability block on 'unprompted_complexity' prevents new progress there, and active project slots are full; therefore, no new projects are initiated. The continuity probe validates the current frontier while acknowledging the incomplete history.

detail.title: Unprompted Complexity Growth
detail.question: Can an intelligent process evolve toward greater complexity without being instructed to become more complex?
detail.reason: Attention constraints and capability blocks limit progress on this project, requiring it to remain parked despite being an active interest.
